# Procedure episode template API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A reusable template that prefills a new procedure episode.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `procedureepisodetemplate` (detail, create, update), `procedureepisodetemplates` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 200 characters. Descriptive name for this template. |
| `projects` | list of [`project`](/api/stem/project/) ids. Share with these projects. Leave empty to keep personal. |
| `intervention_class` | one of `anesthesia_only`, `surgical`, `non_surgical`, `euthanasia_tissue_collection`, `clinical_treatment`, `other` **[required]** |
| `intervention_class_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `protocol` | [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) id; nullable |
| `licenses` | list of [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) ids |
| `severity` | choice (see the list below); nullable |
| `recovery_outcome` | one of `unknown`, `recovered`, `ongoing_recovery`, `non_recovery`, `planned_terminal`, `humane_endpoint`, `unexpected_death`, `aborted`, `cancelled` **[required]** |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `summary` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |

- `severity` choices: `eu_2010_63_non_recovery`, `eu_2010_63_mild`, `eu_2010_63_moderate`, `eu_2010_63_severe`, `uk_aspa_sub_threshold`, `uk_aspa_non_recovery`, `uk_aspa_mild`, `uk_aspa_moderate`, `uk_aspa_severe`, `us_iacuc_usda_no_pain_distress`, `us_iacuc_usda_pain_distress_relieved`, `us_iacuc_usda_pain_distress_unrelieved`, `ca_ccac_category_a`, `ca_ccac_category_b`, `ca_ccac_category_c`, `ca_ccac_category_d`, `ca_ccac_category_e`, `local_institutional_sub_threshold`, `local_institutional_non_recovery`, `local_institutional_mild`, `local_institutional_moderate`, `local_institutional_severe`, `not_applicable`

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('procedureepisodetemplate', load_all=True)
records = resp['procedureepisodetemplates']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('procedureepisodetemplate', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.procedureepisodetemplates;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('procedureepisodetemplate', data={"name": "Procedure episode template 1", "intervention_class": "anesthesia_only", "recovery_outcome": "unknown"})
record = resp.json()['procedureepisodetemplate']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Procedure episode template 1', 'intervention_class', 'anesthesia_only', 'recovery_outcome', 'unknown'), 'procedureepisodetemplate');
record = created.procedureepisodetemplate;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('procedureepisodetemplate', id='<id>', data={"name": "Procedure episode template 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Procedure episode template 1 (renamed)'), 'procedureepisodetemplate', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('procedureepisodetemplate', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'procedureepisodetemplate');
```
